description: Fix CSV formula injection in exports, SSE stream resource leaks, workflow executor infinite loop on cyclic graphs, deals import invalid date crash, automation condition operator defaulting to match-all, and import modal missing file size validation
steps: 1. CSV Formula Injection in exports: In lib/export/index.ts, the escapeCSV() function does not strip leading formula characters (=, +, -, @, \t, \r). A contact with firstName '=CMD("calc")' would be exported as a dangerous formula. Also fix the duplicate escapeCSV in app/api/tenant/deals/export/route.ts. Prefix any cell value starting with =, +, -, @, \t, or \r with a single quote to neutralize formula injection.

2. SSE Notification Stream resource leak: In app/api/tenant/notifications/stream/route.ts, when the client disconnects (abort signal fires), clearInterval is called but controller.close() is never called. This means the ReadableStream stays open server-side. Add controller.close() in the abort handler after clearing intervals. Also, the sendUnread function catches errors but does not close the controller on persistent DB failures - add a fail counter that closes the stream after 3 consecutive DB errors.

3. Workflow executor infinite loop on cyclic graphs: In lib/automation/workflow-executor.ts, the executeNode() function recursively walks children but has no cycle detection. If a workflow graph has cycles (A -> B -> A), it will stack overflow. Add a visited Set<string> parameter that tracks nodeIds already executed, and skip any node already in the set.

4. Deals import Invalid Date crash: In app/api/tenant/deals/import/route.ts, line creates `new Date(mapped.closeDate)` without validating the date string. If the CSV contains 'TBD' or '13/25/2024' or any non-parseable string, new Date() returns Invalid Date which will cause a DB insert error that crashes the entire transaction. Add validation: check if the parsed date is valid (isNaN(date.getTime())) and skip the field if invalid, pushing a non-fatal warning to results.errors.

5. Automation engine condition operator fallthrough: In lib/automation/engine.ts, the meetsConditions() switch has `default: return true`. This means any unknown/misspelled operator (e.g., 'greaterThan' instead of 'greater_than') silently matches all records. Change the default case to return false, so unknown operators fail closed. Same fix in lib/automation/workflow-executor.ts evaluateCondition() function.

6. Import modal missing file size check: In components/tenant/import-modal.tsx, the handleFile() function only checks the file extension/type but not the file size. The server allows 50,000 rows but a user could try to load a 500MB file into memory via FileReader. Add a 10MB client-side file size check (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) with a toast error message before reading.

7. Contacts export unsanitized ilike query: In lib/export/index.ts generateExportData(), the 'q' filter parameter is interpolated directly into ilike() without escaping SQL wildcards (%, _). A query like '%' would match everything. Escape % and _ in the q parameter before passing to ilike. Same issue exists in app/api/tenant/contacts/route.ts GET handler's q parameter - fix both.

8. Add/update unit tests: Add a test file tests/unit/csv-export-sanitize.test.ts testing the escapeCSV function with formula injection payloads. Add a test for the cycle detection in workflow-executor. Add a test for the condition operator default behavior.
acceptance_criteria: escapeCSV('=CMD()') returns a string starting with single-quote prefix that neutralizes the formula
The notification stream SSE handler calls controller.close() when the abort signal fires
executeNode in workflow-executor.ts tracks visited nodes and returns early on revisit to prevent infinite loops
Deals import with close_date='TBD' produces a warning but does not crash the transaction
meetsConditions with operator 'unknown_op' returns false (not true)
Import modal rejects files larger than 10MB with a user-facing error toast
ilike queries with user-supplied search terms escape % and _ wildcards
npx tsc --noEmit passes with no type errors in modified files
